text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Ooooooooooh...!!
Fine Motiooooon~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators A & B
text_block_list.text:
"Fine Motiooooon!!
*sniff*... Waaaahhhhh~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Aaah, I lost.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I'm super, super, super
frustrated... but I'm also really happy.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Because I got to compete
against the real Fine-san!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Scarlett-chan,
...thank you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...!
N-No, you don't need to thank me...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations!
Well then...!
(Waaaaaaaaaaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... thank you.
We've finally arrived—at such a wonderful view.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...How're you feeling?
Don't let anything other than 'top-notch' come out of your mouth."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's the best!
If it ends with this, I have no regrets.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Right. 'Course I feel good.
I won, after all...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I knew it all from the start.
I lose right here, and that's the end of me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but that's borin' as hell.
I've been lookin' for somethin' that can twist the ending out of shape.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shakur...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And that's when you caught my eye... Fine.
At first, I was just analyzing your data
because you were different from the rest.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yet on that day, you defied all predictions.
At that exact moment... the thought crossed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"If anyone can rewrite a predetermined fate...
maybe it's this one?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If I change your ending—if I keep you running,
the premise collapses, and my ending should change too.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I decided to believe that hypothesis...
I foolishly clung to it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And in the end, it was the same lame conclusion predicted by the data.
Pretty hilarious, right? Go on, laugh, Fine.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...I won't laugh.
Because Shakur hasn't given up yet.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Haaah?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Because today's race is still replaying in your head right now, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You still want to win.
You're far too noble to simply accept defeat.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: There's no way it can end like this. That's why—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Then the same goes for you, doesn't it...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You still wanna win, don't you!?
You wanna run, don't you!?
Then why the hell are you running away!?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't run away!
Don't you dare act like you're out of the game...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Prove it to me.
That you can overturn any condition...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Shakur.
However, I'll leave that to you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You've gathered so much data on me.
Inside you, I can keep on running.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Run for me.
Win, Shakur... and prove it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
......It wasn't for your sake.
I told you, this is all for me, dammit.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Dammit, this really pisses me off...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...How was the heat from "here",
Your Highness?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That was the best!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Shakur...
Goodbye."

"After this, a press conference was arranged
for her to announce her return to Japan."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm fine.
...Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm so blessed, aren't I?
I really, truly am such a lucky girl.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I ran so much, made friends,
and received so much wonderful cheering."
choice_data_list: No one will ever forget the impact you made.
No one will ever forget the shock you delivered.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
I'm sure they won't forget.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I believe that we can become a sparkling memory—

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
—Fine-chan!
Don't quit! Please stay in racing!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
However, my blissful three years are coming to an end.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
This beautiful ending
was decided from the very beginning.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Races begin, and then they end. Yet, within our memories, they transcend victory and defeat..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
As long as everyone remembers me,
my feelings will live on.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Please... keep Fine Motion
in your heart, okay?

As she smiled, her eyes
sparkled brighter than ever before—
